independent_reference.source: Step 0 (IC) field sum = sum(clip(0.5·exp(-||x-cx||²/(2·sigma_ic²)) + 0.05·rng.random((64,64)), 0, 1)) with rng = numpy.random.default_rng(seed=42), sigma_ic = 64/8 = 8. The IC is fully deterministic from the seed; the field sum at step 0 is independent of the Taichi forward update (no Taichi kernel involved yet). Reproducible byte-for-byte by lenia._init_orbium_field(grid=64, seed=42).

Step 0 IC max = max over (i,j) of clip(0.5·exp(-||x-cx||²/(2·sigma_ic²)) + 0.05·rng.random((64,64)), 0, 1). The Gaussian blob peaks at the center cell ((32, 32) for grid=64) with value 0.5·exp(0) = 0.5; the perturbation at the center is 0.05·rng_value. The deterministic max location is at or near the center; max value = 0.5 + 0.05·rng[32, 32]. Reproducible byte-for-byte from the seed.

Step 1 field sum = sum(clip(A_0 + dt·G(K * A_0; mu, sigma), 0, 1)) where K is the normalized Quad4 kernel (LeniaF.py:493), G is the Quad4 polynomial growth (LeniaF.py:500), dt=0.1. The forward Euler step is deterministic + bit-exact from the pinned seed under set_taichi_deterministic(arch='cpu'). Reproducible byte-for-byte by lenia.LeniaSim(LeniaConfig(seed=42, grid=64, steps=1)).step().

Step 5 field sum = sum after 5 iterations of the deterministic Lenia Euler step starting from the seed-pinned Gaussian-blob IC. The trajectory reflects the Lenia decay regime under this IC: most cells have local-mean convolved values far from mu=0.15, so G saturates to -1 and the cells decay by dt=0.1 per step. Reproducible byte-for-byte under D-DET; falls within the bound |A_{n+1}-A_n| ≤ dt·|G| ≤ dt per the spec-ref §6 second invariant.
